how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sunken-temple-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1445:obj:0: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
rows.quest:1445:details:0: So he spoke of Jammal'an's prophecy?
rows.quest:1445:details:1: BThe Atal'ai spiritual leader believes once Hakkar returns to ⟦E1⟧ from the Nether, the god will grant the Atal'ai tribe immortality.
rows.quest:1445:details:2: BFoolish trickery to bring about a premature doomsday if you ask me.
rows.quest:1445:details:3: BBut you say the exile spoke of enchanted fetishes? This concerns me greatly. If these are in fact the key to the Atal'ai ritual which caused this mess, we must understand their intrinsic powers.
rows.quest:1445:details:4: BVenture into the Temple, and seize the fetishes!
rows.quest:1445:completion:0: Brave ⟦1⟧, you have proven yourself to be a great champion of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1445:completion:1: BNow this collection of fetishes of Hakkar must be dealt with at once!
rows.quest:1446:obj:0: The Atal'ai Exile in ⟦E3⟧ wants the Head of Jammal'an.
rows.quest:1446:details:0: My Witherbark companions don't take kindly to strangers around their home.
rows.quest:1446:details:1: BMe? I don't have a home anymore. I was exiled from my people, the great Atal'ai tribe of the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1446:details:2: BOur spiritual leader, Jammal'an, had what he called a prophecy. He believes the summoning of the god, Hakkar will bring the Atal'ai immortality.
rows.quest:1446:details:3: BBut I urged caution. What if the prophecy was nothing more than manipulation?
rows.quest:1446:details:4: BI want revenge for my exile. Bring me Jammal'an's head. Maybe then my people will be free.
rows.quest:1446:completion:0: Jammal'an's reckless trust of false visions led my people to their eternal doom.
rows.quest:1446:completion:1: BI thank you, ⟦2⟧, for avenging my exile. I mourn for my people. I have no home to return to.
rows.quest:1475:obj:0: Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1475:details:0: According to legend, The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is a holy shrine dedicated to the ancient god, Hakkar the Soulflayer. Maintained by a vicious tribe of trolls named the Atal'ai, the temple is rumored to be impenetrable.
rows.quest:1475:details:1: BNow sunk beneath the Pool of Tears, retrieving artifacts from the temple is even more difficult. But that's what I need you to do, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:1475:details:2: BAid me by gathering the intact Atal'ai Tablets. Bring them to me and I will return to the Explorers' Guild a hero. Together we will share the glory.
rows.quest:1475:completion:1: BOnce I deliver these to the Explorers' League our names shall go down in history together. You have helped an old dwarf fulfill his final obligation in life. For that I am eternally grateful.
rows.quest:3373:obj:0: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
rows.quest:3373:details:0: As you touch the gem, a deep voice resonates in your mind.
rows.quest:3373:details:1: B"Mortal, heed this plea. I am Eranikus of the Green Dragonflight, keeper of this accursed temple. My charge to ensure that the trolls never again bring forth their abomination of a god has for now ended in failure. As I imbue this gem with part of my essence, I sense my grip on the Dream twisting into chaos. Please - place this gem into the essence font in my lair, and let our magic there purge the taint from my psyche so that I may rest."
rows.quest:3373:completion:0: You place the gem inside the essence font.
rows.quest:3373:completion:1: B"Thank you mortal, you have - no... this, this cannot be! No! The corruption of this accursed god even taints the sanctity of a Green Dragonflight essence font! No please, I feel my essence ripping from me! THE PAIN! I feel the grip of an eternal nightmare taking hold on me..."
rows.quest:3373:completion:2: B"Mortal, I implore you! Find one of the Green Dragonflight to stop this... help me... I am chained in darkness... forever in agony... please do not torture..."
rows.quest:3380:details:0: There are restless spirits in this world, ⟦5⟧. There are spirits that have been tainted by their isolation, bound to an ancient evil...
rows.quest:3380:details:1: BI have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.
rows.quest:3380:details:2: BIf you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. He has studied many ancient areas of the world, and was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:3380:completion:0: Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?
rows.quest:3380:completion:1: BYou look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...
rows.quest:3446:obj:0: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3446:details:0: Inside the temple, I found a circular room with six balconies, each one with a serpent statue on the edge. Curious, I pushed one of them to see what would happen, and it was a trap! I nearly fell to my death from the explosion. Laying there on the ledge, I looked down and noticed that there was another statue at the base of the room; an altar of sorts... Hakkar, I think it was called.
rows.quest:3446:details:1: BI think that this altar is the secret -- you must bring this token to the altar in the Sunken Temple.
rows.quest:3446:completion:0: You push the stone circle into the opening, and you hear it lock into place.
rows.quest:3446:completion:1: BNow that the stone is in place, you may continue... but what should you do next?
rows.quest:3446:completion:2: BPerhaps you should examine this altar further...
rows.quest:3447:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
rows.quest:3447:details:0: My memories are cloudy, but I will tell you what I can. The circle of statues in the Sunken Temple, while dangerous, I believe that they hold the secret to unlock an even greater treasure.
rows.quest:3447:details:1: BFrom the main altar, I was able to activate a series of lights. I think that if you can uncover what these lights mean, you might be able to unlock whatever secrets are hiding in this room.
rows.quest:3447:details:2: BI warn you though, ⟦6⟧. Great evil lies in the temple. It's likely that anything valuable will be fervently guarded...
rows.quest:3447:completion:0: The eye of the idol glitters brightly even in the half-darkness of the temple. Its transparency reveals something shiny behind it. Sliding it to the side, you reach in and grasp what lies inside the statue.
rows.quest:3447:completion:1: BThe Atal'ai treasure is now yours.
rows.quest:3528:obj:0: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:3528:details:0: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.
rows.quest:3528:details:1: BTake the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in ⟦E1⟧. Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.
rows.quest:3528:details:2: BHe will send his minions against you. Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit. When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.
rows.quest:3528:details:3: BDefeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
rows.quest:3528:completion:0: The essence of Hakkar has been collected! Even now the Egg stirs with life! Could the myths of Hakkar be true?
rows.quest:3528:completion:1: BThat must not be true, for it is then I fear what Hakkar may do if birthed again. I will keep this egg safe and be sure it does not fall into evil hands.
rows.quest:3528:completion:2: BYour labors with me are finished, ⟦7⟧. You have touched a legend, and your actions may one day change the face of our world.
rows.quest:4146:obj:0: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4146:details:0: You're in luck, ⟦8⟧! I've been working on some of my own experiments while Marvon's been gone, and one of them is a short range bug zapper. With just a few adjustments, it should be great for ridding yourself of those Bloodpetal pests.
rows.quest:4146:details:1: BI can let you have one of my zapper prototypes, but you'll still need to collect the fuel. You can get the necessary Atal'ai haze that the zapper needs in the temple of Atal'Hakkar. The deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes are the ones you'll need to get it from.
rows.quest:4146:completion:0: So, Marvon wasn't around? Well, show me what you got, anyway.
rows.quest:8733:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the continent of ⟦E8⟧ and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of ⟦E9⟧.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:8733:details:0: This is a journey of redemption, hero. Would it be that I was slain today, I would have died for a just and righteous cause. You must recover the green scepter shard. You must cleanse Eranikus of the taint placed upon him by the Old Gods.
rows.quest:8733:details:1: BTravel to ⟦E9⟧. Just outside the city walls you will find one of my agents. This agent will set things in motion for us and inform Tyrande of our plans without alerting Staghelm.
rows.quest:8733:details:3: BA fall from grace a thousand years in the making...
rows.quest:8733:completion:0: The wisp is silent except for a low humming sound. Oddly enough, it is able to communicate with you through thoughts.
